title: Sci-Fi
story: Gadgets and gear for a cozy trip out among the stars.

cards.name: Flying Saucer
cards.subject: A classic flying saucer in flight: a perfectly round, symmetrical disc with a smooth dome on top, a row of round lights around the rim and a rounded underside, no landing legs.
cards.hero_colors: silver grey with pale grey glass dome and a small accent of yellow rim lights

cards.name: Rocket
cards.subject: A rocket flying upward: a symmetrical white cylinder with a pointed red nose cone, one round porthole window, four red fins around the base, and a bright fire with a yellow-white glowing core, orange flame tips curling downward and warm orange light cast on the body.
cards.hero_colors: white body, red nose cone and fins, grey window, orange flame

cards.name: Space Helmet
cards.subject: A round white astronaut helmet with a wide curved gold visor, a thick ring collar at the neck and a small side light.
cards.hero_colors: white helmet with a gold visor and a small red light

cards.name: Satellite
cards.subject: A satellite: a boxy gold foil body with two flat rectangular solar panels attached on rods to opposite sides and a round dish on top.
cards.hero_colors: gold foil body, dark blue panels, silver dish

cards.name: Glow Flask
cards.subject: A conical glass lab flask with a narrow neck, filled halfway with glowing green liquid and closed with a cork stopper.
cards.hero_colors: clear glass, bright green liquid, light brown cork

cards.name: Star Map
cards.subject: A flat rectangular chart lying face up, with dotted lines joining small star icons and a few circles.
cards.hero_colors: deep blue paper with white lines and a yellow star accent

cards.name: Moon Rover
cards.subject: A moon rover: a white boxy body on six black wheels, a small dish antenna on a mast fixed to the top and a front camera box.
cards.hero_colors: white body, black wheels, small orange dish

cards.name: Radar Dish
cards.subject: A large round white radar dish tilted upward on a thick grey pedestal bolted to a round concrete pad, with a short feed arm in front of the dish.
cards.hero_colors: white dish, grey pedestal, small orange feed tip

cards.name: Control Panel
cards.subject: A rectangular grey metal panel fixed to a wall with a small round screen, two rows of round buttons, three sliders and one big round button.
cards.hero_colors: grey metal with a big red button

cards.name: Round Hatch
